words.translation: The pleasant, earthy smell of rain on dry soil.
words.sentence1: The sudden summer shower brought out a lovely petrichor that filled the garden. (The sudden summer shower brought out a lovely smell of rain that filled the garden.)
words.sentence2: After months of drought, the first rain released a deep petrichor across the valley. (After months of drought, the first rain released a deep earthy scent across the valley.)

words.translation: The time spent relaxing and talking after a meal.
words.sentence1: Disfrutamos de una larga sobremesa con café y anécdotas. (We enjoyed a long time talking after the meal with coffee and stories.)
words.sentence2: La sobremesa es mi parte favorita de las reuniones familiares. (The post-meal conversation is my favorite part of family gatherings.)

words.translation: Lasting for a very short time; fleeting.
words.sentence1: La beauté d'un coucher de soleil est toujours éphémère. (The beauty of a sunset is always fleeting.)
words.sentence2: Nous avons partagé un moment éphémère de paix au bord du lac. (We shared a fleeting moment of peace by the lake.)

words.translation: A longing for far-off places; wanderlust.
words.sentence1: Wenn ich den alten Atlas aufschlage, packt mich sofort das Fernweh. (When I open the old atlas, I am immediately overcome by wanderlust.)
words.sentence2: Sie konnte ihr Fernweh nicht länger unterdrücken und buchte ein Flugticket. (She could no longer suppress her longing for far-off places and booked a plane ticket.)

words.translation: Sunlight filtering through the leaves of trees.
words.sentence1: 森の中の木漏れ日がとても美しかった。 (The sunlight filtering through the trees in the forest was very beautiful.)
words.sentence2: 木漏れ日を浴びながら散歩をするのが好きだ。 (I like taking walks while bathing in the sunlight filtering through the trees.)

words.translation: To rest in the shade during the hottest hours of the day.
words.sentence1: Ci piace meriggiare sotto i pini durante le calde giornate estive. (We like resting in the shade under the pine trees during the hot summer days.)
words.sentence2: Il gatto ha scelto di meriggiare nel punto più fresco del giardino. (The cat chose to rest in the shade in the coolest spot of the garden.)

words.translation: Years; the passage of time; time and experience.
words.sentence1: 岁月如梭，转眼间我们都长大了。 (Time flies like a shuttle; in the blink of an eye, we have all grown up.)
words.sentence2: 她经历过岁月的洗礼，变得更加从容淡定。 (Having gone through the baptism of time, she has become more calm and composed.)

words.translation: A short, deep sleep from which you wake up but then fall back into.
words.sentence1: 일요일 아침, 그루잠을 자는 시간만큼 행복한 것은 없다. (On Sunday mornings, there is nothing as happy as the time spent in a short, deep sleep.)
words.sentence2: 그루잠 끝에 꾼 꿈은 무척이나 평화로웠다. (The dream I had after falling back into a short, deep sleep was very peaceful.)

words.sentence1: សេរីភាពគឺជាក្តីប្រាថ្នារបស់មនុស្សគ្រប់រូប។ (Freedom is the desire of every human being.)
words.sentence2: យើងចង់បានសេរីភាពក្នុងការជ្រើសរើសផ្លូវជីវិតផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន។ (We want the freedom to choose our own paths in life.)

words.sentence1: Dit was 'n baie gesellige aand met goeie vriende. (It was a very cozy and sociable evening with good friends.)
words.sentence2: Hulle het 'n gesellige huisie in die platteland. (They have a cozy, friendly house in the countryside.)
